title: Durable run records must not carry host-absolute paths (role-result report_path)
description:
Found on the ticks PR #80 opened by the Phase 1 gate run: .ticfac/runs/gate-cia-2/decisions/{1,2}.json carry result.report_path as a host-absolute path under the operator's home directory (the executor's state root), which is operator-specific content in a public repository (ticks' public-repo guard and ticfac's own Rules forbid it). Every durable record on the integration branch — attempt, decision, evidence, checkpoint — must carry only run-relative facts: make report_path relative to the attempt worktree root (or the artifact_prefix), and audit the executor's JobResult/RoleResult and the reconciler's provenance for any other absolute path or hostname (state_root in the dispatch marker's job_handle is the reconciler's identity for adoption — keep what adoption needs but store it under an explicitly local, non-durable key or relative to the state root recorded once). Add a test that scans every record a fixture run pushes to origin for '/Users/', '/home/', the temp dir and the hostname, and fails on any hit. Scope: internal/exec/subprocess (report_path) and internal/reconcile (records/provenance).

## How this fits
Wave 6 of epic qeu; wtd (artifact exclusion in the executor) has just merged at c57477e6e9235d24f3572912687c603c8f889e3d — build on it. No other worker is active. Stdlib only; no go.mod/README/contracts edits. Verify your base: git merge-base --is-ancestor c57477e6e9235d24f3572912687c603c8f889e3d HEAD.
